jobs.title: Backend Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text:
About Ledgerline
We build reconciliation software for Indian fintechs.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain REST APIs in Python (Django) backed by PostgreSQL.
- Write tests and ship features with code review from senior engineers.
- Containerise services with Docker and help improve our CI pipeline.

Who you are
- Currently pursuing a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or a related field (graduating 2027 or 2028).
- Comfortable with Python and SQL; you have built at least one backend project.
- Bonus: open source contributions, experience with Node.js or React.

This is a 6-month internship in our Bengaluru office.

jobs.title: Sales Development Intern
jobs.description_text:
Brightcart is a D2C commerce platform. As a Sales Development Intern you will:
- Make 60+ outbound cold calls a day to prospective merchants.
- Qualify leads and book demos for account executives.
- Keep HubSpot CRM records up to date.

Requirements
- Excellent spoken English and Hindi or Kannada.
- An MBA or BBA (pursuing) is preferred.
- Target-driven, comfortable with daily call quotas.

Stipend plus incentives on booked demos.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Ferrovia Cloud runs managed Kubernetes for logistics companies.

You will own our internal platform: Kubernetes clusters, Terraform modules and the Go services that provision them.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional experience running production infrastructure.
- Strong Go and Kubernetes experience; Terraform and AWS.
- On-call participation.

This is a full-time, permanent position, remote within India.
